name: Save the Bloogs
summary: In Save the Bloogs, players guide tiny, lovable creatures through environments filled with obstacles, traps, and platforms, placing physical pieces on the Board to create paths and clever solutions. Across four different worlds — from dense forests to dangerous volcanoes — each level challenges players to think and experiment, combining logic, timing, and cooperation to save as many Bloogs as possible, in an experience that uniquely blends strategy, physics, and humor.
